thread:
olivia: Quick sync — planning a prelaunch geo-burst experiment for the new routing fallback flow. Goal: validate burst+slice behavior under regional surge without impacting tiered customers. thinking lite A/B slices + explicit burst cap + automatic degrade to hosted-lite.

samir: SGTM. What are the gating signals?

olivia: Acceptance criteria draft: 1) p95 latency stays within +30% of baseline, 2) error rate < 0.5% sustained, 3) no single tenant > 3x usual tokens/min, 4) cost delta per-minute under $X for the slice. if any fail -> immediate rollback/fallback.

dave: Need to be explicit about per-tenant quotas and token-based throttles. otherwise a noisy customer will eat the slice. also: how do we enforce the region burst cap?

olivia: plan: feature-flagged slices per-region. example flag: `ff.burst.slice.eu-west.v1 = {"quota":2000/min, "slice_pct":2, "fallback":"hosted-lite"}`. enforcement via token-meter in proxy + per-tenant soft quota.

nora: Customer gating — we should offer opt-in for early partners and an opt-out path. also require a customer-facing escalation contact.

samir: telemetry to gate: network error spikes, model rejection rate, tail latency (p99), and VM GPU load. thresholds: error_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p99 latency > baseline*2 for 3m -> trigger circuit. Also add a cost-surge monitor: tokens/min * model-cost > budget -> hold traffic.

olivia: rollout steps: 0.5% of global traffic but limited to eu-west/us-central (warm hardware) -> hold 60m + manual review -> 2% slice for same regions -> hold 2h -> 10% slice and widen to APAC. at each hold we evaluate the acceptance criteria.

dave: emergency fallback plan: immediate routing to compat model (m-reduced) and gradual teardown of batching. feature flags must include a kill-switch tag so ops can flip to fallback within 30s.

olivia: sample FF naming and ops commands: `ff set ff.burst.slice.eu-west.v1 enabled=false --actor ops` and a kill-switch endpoint: `POST /ops/rollout/{slice}/kill` returns 202.

samir: ops runbook checklist (short): 1) confirm shard capacity in region, 2) enable telemetry dashboards (slice + tenant), 3) pre-warm fallback model, 4) set automated alerts for thresholds above, 5) standby on-call.

nora: can we auto-exempt VIP tenants? e.g., exclude customers with SLA or paid priority so they never get routed to slice unless explicitly opted-in.

dave: yes. add `exclude_tenants: [tenant-id...]` in flag payload. ops should also have a fast-override to add/remove tenants.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment for `routing-burst-v3` succeeded in eu-west at 3780012340 :white_check_mark:

olivia: Great — I'll create a short runbook doc and attach prelaunch checklist. will add a link to the customer opt-in form. follow-up: @samir @dave can you sketch the alert pages and perms by EOD? :slightly_smiling_face:

samir: on it. I’ll drop a dashboard link here when ready.

nora: I’ll coordinate partner opt-ins and share contact list.

olivia: thanks team. we’ll keep this thread for quick updates during the bake window. :rocket:
